how: enterScene(door) is where almost every way of moving ends: a passage, a world way, a rope bridge, a ladder, then scriptGo (the only one that reaches a script), else the door's own fixed destination, drawn with the scene.

navigation.event: Arrow or edge-walk out of an outdoor square
navigation.decides: worldTarget: the square's links (another world), else worldMeets, the neighbour in state.world.cells with a way back
navigation.note: a way linked to another world is not scripted

navigation.event: Letting go of a sign board
navigation.decides: signWays, then the same route as an arrow

navigation.event: Falling into a trap-room pit (walking on, landing a jump, a lid opening underneath)
navigation.decides: pitAt; its room from the castle's dungeon1/dungeon2; only an open, uncovered pit

navigation.event: A dungeon's ladder up (its way out)
navigation.decides: wayOutOf: auto is the trap room if there is one, else 0 or 1

navigation.event: Castle room doors, signs, arches and far-wall stairs
navigation.decides: castleWays and roomExits: the castle's rooms, each hall's out, back, far and doors, ROOM_KINDS' exits
navigation.note: only a ladder room's way out reaches a script

navigation.event: Toward-us arrows inside (living room, huts, tree top, tree room)
navigation.decides: insideWays: the place's own back key (livingOut, treetopBack, treeBackN, …)

navigation.event: Tree-house doors, hatches, ladders, bridges, windows
navigation.decides: houseLinks, treeWalks, bridgeOn; a shut hatch is no door

navigation.event: Huts, the witch's house, the clearing, the living room's door

navigation.decides: one door per kind of place

navigation.event: Cave passages placed by the player
navigation.decides: passageWalk: the passage's twin, in this world or another (worldById)

navigation.event: Design-panel jumps (a place chosen, a world switched, a person switched)

other.decides: the square's things: the lever's works, does, and each door's open and boulder
trapState: the wiring, the pits open
trapState: the wiring, the pits on, covered

other.event: A tree room's or the tree top's hatch lever
Walking into a door to push it
other.decides: the door's glow (ends at the door's own way)
the water's depth, the pits under the landing
the path planned round pits and solids
